resources.note: Actual private MCP HTTP, review OAuth, SQLite Durable Object, Ed25519 signing, Candid/CBOR and response formatter. Real SDK BLS verification of root/subnet certificates and Ed25519 query signatures enabled; local root key fetched via status. Both corrupt query signatures and corrupt certificates are rejected before measurement. Search candidates simulate producer-side improved previews. The product retrieval pipeline and shared Jev implementation run unchanged except for the local Jev endpoint. Provider replies and network waits are fixture-controlled; live provider quality/latency measured separately. CPU is owned workerd process kernel CPU including DO, not Cloudflare billed isolate CPU. Heap is sampled main-isolate V8 use, not a strict true peak or full isolate-memory measurement.

notes: Accuracy uses public source snapshots, fixed corrected labels and 46 actual Jev calls. P@3 measures retrieved relevance, not generated-answer correctness.
First 38 candidate selections/excerpts also match the frozen experiment exactly. Confirmation candidate lists were recaptured, gold targets unchanged.
Resource CPU is local workerd process CPU including DO, not Cloudflare billed isolate CPU. Main-isolate heap/backing sampling is not a strict peak or full production-memory measure.
Model/canister responses and network waits are fixtures only in the resource run; accuracy uses the real provider.

The 96 MiB regression gate applies to every new retrieval-search scenario, including failures. Existing ten-body-read control measured 136.2 MiB in the signed verification run (164.2 MiB in the first signed run); this remains a separate resource concern, outside the search gate.
Wasm instruction measurements use the same store/runtime code in a diagnostic feature build. The final production Wasm omits the benchmark query.

Review correction: resources is the signed run with root/subnet BLS certificates, 13 node public keys, Ed25519 query verification, and corrupt-signature/certificate rejection checks. The prior unsigned run is retained only under resourcesWithoutSignatureVerification and is not acceptance evidence for the production verification path. Production Worker/SDK code is not rewritten by the benchmark; only the Jev URL points to a local fixture. Each of the 104 concurrent-search requests fetched its own certificate and local root key; all 312 queries were signed.
